(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Previously presented) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor, and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 5: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation prior to the cooled air flowing through an opening.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening located in the housing.

(Previously presented) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

(Currently amended) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill. 

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: in a housing for mounting within a structure wall, a cooling system that evaporatively cools an indoor area. 

(Previously presented) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes supports positioned to mount the cooling system between wall studs spaced at least sixteen inches on center.
